2459-5006-8095-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
2459-5006-8095-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Rograkh, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

413-1981-5070.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-5070.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Angelic Chorus trigger.
Resolve the Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

643-5315-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-5315-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

215-1322-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-1322-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2741-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2741-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

4082-4640-5147--201.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Kemba triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-4435-7737.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-7280-7704.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1172-1624-3024.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Complete the Circuit by paying {5}{U}, reduced by the Convoke ability if possible.
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 3 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

240-969-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

1978-2585-7290.description:
Animate Grim Monolith using Does Machines.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Grim Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

2099-3685-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
2099-3685-6747.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters, its first ability triggers, targeting either a permanent an opponent controls or itself if an opponent doesn't control a targetable permanent.
Holding priority, activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah.
If you targeted Spine of Ish Sah in step 2, the ability will fizzle due to having no legal target.
Spine of Ish Sah's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability from step 3.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger from step 2, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.

3372-3680-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Stunt Double
3372-3680-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Stunt Double's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Stunt Double's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Stunt Double's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-2341-3349-4659.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Glissa triggers, choosing the first mode.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Glissa's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Glissa's trigger, creating two Incubator tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Incubators, untapping The Peregrine Dynamo.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an Incubator, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1231-3967-4826-6644.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

826-1636-4050-6243.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1636-4050-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

618-1734-5231.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token, adding {R}.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

198-751-5068.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
198-751-5068.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Lapis Lazuli Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Empowered Autogenerator.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3764-4871.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

3609-4235-4772.manaNeeded: {2} each odd-numbered turn, with {6} available each even-numbered turn
3609-4235-4772.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has at least three charge counters on it.
3609-4235-4772.description:
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate's Scepter's abilities, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate's Scepter's abilities, putting four charge counters on it.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

147-1638-2060-3129.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Primal Vigor.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
